description: A non-streamed Gemini request whose history has a model functionCall (with a thought part before it and a thoughtSignature on the call) and a user functionResponse with the same id: the upstream Responses input carries a function_call and a function_call_output with that call ID, and the text reply comes back as one Gemini candidate.
source: core/internal/translator/codex/gemini/codex_gemini_request.go (functionCall to function_call, functionResponse to function_call_output; IDs preserved; hidden thought parts dropped; thoughtSignature handling)
core/internal/translator/codex/gemini/codex_gemini_response.go (non-stream: output message text to a text part)

parts.text: I should look up the weather.

exceptions.reason: The new core writes the Gemini reply the same way for every upstream format: candidate index 0, the serving model in modelVersion, one chunk per text or thought delta, and a last chunk holding the finish reason, any function calls and usageMetadata (with Gemini's inclusion rules: promptTokenCount includes cached tokens, candidatesTokenCount leaves out thoughtsTokenCount). Today's Codex translator opens with an empty chunk, adds createTime and usageMetadata.trafficType PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT, leaves out the candidate index and cached and thought token counts, names the requested model after the first chunk, and turns Responses encrypted reasoning into a thoughtSignature carrier on the next text part (Codex reasoning carry-over is the Codex provider's, slice 9); the new core reports the encrypted reasoning as dropped.

Today's core reaches a Responses upstream only through its Codex API-key provider, which reshapes the request for the Codex endpoint (system as developer, empty instructions, include, store false, parallel_tool_calls, tool_choice auto, strict false and additionalProperties false on tools, prompt_cache_key and Session-Id, an image_generation tool, every request streamed). The new core's generic Responses upstream gets the translated request without them; Codex endpoint rules belong to the Codex provider extension.
